extDescription.message: Save any page to your own self-hosted TileMark in one click.
extDescription.description: Store and manifest description, at most 132 characters

commandOpen.message: Open the Save to TileMark window

cannotSave.message: This page can't be saved. Only web pages (http and https) can.

err_setup.message: Connect the extension to your TileMark first.

err_noPermission.message: The extension may not reach {server} yet. Open the settings and press Save and test.

err_offline.message: Can't reach TileMark at {server}. Check the address and that TileMark is running.

err_redirect.message: TileMark answered with a redirect: usually a login page in front of it (Authelia, Authentik, basic auth) or the Home Assistant sidebar address. Use TileMark's own address and let /api/ through.

err_notTileMark.message: That address answered, but not like TileMark. Check the address.

err_badKey.message: TileMark did not accept the API key. Create one in TileMark under Your account → Save from anywhere and paste it in the extension's settings.

err_refused.message: TileMark refused this request. If a proxy or firewall rule sits in front of TileMark, let /api/ through; otherwise update TileMark to the latest version.

optIntro.message: Connect this browser to your TileMark. The address and the API key stay in this browser only.

serverHint.message: The address you open TileMark at. For the Home Assistant app, use TileMark's own address (its direct port), not the sidebar.

apiKeyHint.message: In TileMark: Your account → Save from anywhere → Create API key. Every account has one key: Replace API key in TileMark stops the old key everywhere, also in an iPhone Shortcut.

invalidAddress.message: That doesn't look like a web address.

permissionDenied.message: The browser did not allow access to {server}. The extension needs it to save links there.

warnHttp.message: This address uses plain http, so the API key travels unencrypted. That's fine at home on your own network; from outside, use HTTPS.

warnHomeAssistant.message: This looks like Home Assistant's own address. The extension can't go through the Home Assistant sidebar: use TileMark's own address (its direct port).

menuGroupLast.message: The group last used in the Save window

forget.message: Remove the address and key from this browser
